# İbrahim Atmaca

> Senior Mobile Engineer building iOS, Android and Flutter apps, with a focus on fintech, payments and polished user experience. Open to new freelance and collaboration projects. The site is available in English and Turkish.

## Main pages

- [Home (English)](https://ibrahimatmaca.github.io/): Portfolio with services, selected work, working process, background and contact form.
- [Ana sayfa (Türkçe)](https://ibrahimatmaca.github.io/tr): The same portfolio in Turkish.
- [Support](https://ibrahimatmaca.github.io/support): Support request form for the apps.

## What I do

- Native iOS apps in Swift and SwiftUI.
- Android apps in Kotlin.
- Cross-platform apps in Flutter.
- Fintech and payment flows, including POS integrations.
- Taking an idea to a shipped MVP on the App Store.

## Apps

- [Elevana](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6745828686): A manifestation assistant for iPhone that helps you set clear intentions and stay aligned with your goals. Built with SwiftUI. Data stays on the device. See the [Elevana privacy policy](https://ibrahimatmaca.github.io/elevana-privacy).
- Wada Closet: A digital wardrobe for iPhone that matches your clothes to Sanzo Wada's color combinations. See its [privacy policy](https://ibrahimatmaca.github.io/wada-closet-privacy) and [terms of use](https://ibrahimatmaca.github.io/wada-closet-terms).
- KidTales AI: Bedtime Stories: A child-friendly AI story app, in progress. See its [privacy policy](https://ibrahimatmaca.github.io/kidtales-privacy) and [terms of use](https://ibrahimatmaca.github.io/kidtales-terms).
